functions.name: sync_google_tasks
functions.title: Sync Google Tasks
functions.description: Syncs the app's todos with the connected Google Tasks account. Call when the user wants to push todos to Google Tasks, pull tasks from Google Tasks, or run a two-way sync.

direction.description: push sends pending todos to Google Tasks, pull fetches tasks from Google Tasks, both runs a two-way sync

functions.name: orchestrate_agents
functions.title: Orchestrate Agents
functions.description: Assigns open jobs on the live job board to available idle agents. Call when the user wants agents to pick up and start working on pending jobs.

job_id.description: Optional specific job id to assign. If omitted, all open jobs are considered in priority order.

functions.name: chat_with_agent
functions.title: Chat With Agent
functions.description: Sends a message to a specific agent and returns the agent's response, drawing on its memories and the knowledge base. Call when the user wants to talk to a specific agent in the multi-agent system.

agent_id.description: The id of the agent to message

message.description: The message to send to the agent

job_id.description: Optional job context for the conversation

functions.name: qa_feedback_loop
functions.title: QA Feedback Loop
functions.description: Generates prompt refinement suggestions from audit findings and sends them back to the Prompt Lab. The system learns from each audit to improve its own prompt generation. Call when the QA agent has completed an audit and wants to refine the prompts.

project_id.description: ID of the project to refine

prompt_version_id.description: ID of the current prompt version to refine

audit_source.description: Where the audit findings came from

findings.description: The audit findings to generate refinements from

functions.name: score_benchmark
functions.title: Score Against Benchmark
functions.description: Scores a project against an industry benchmark reference using the Visual X 100-point scorecard (visual parity 25%, functionality 20%, accessibility 15%, responsive 10%, performance 10%, security 10%, content/SEO 5%, reliability 5%). Target: 95+. Call when the user wants to validate quality against a benchmark.

project_id.description: ID of the project to score

benchmark_id.description: ID of the benchmark reference to compare against

functions.name: trigger_post_deployment_qa
functions.title: Trigger Post-Deployment QA
functions.description: Automatically triggers testing and validation phases after a deployment goes live. Runs QA audit, security audit, and benchmark scoring, then creates QA refinement suggestions if issues are found. Call when a deployment task is completed.

deployment_id.description: ID of the deployment that just went live
